tools.name: get_repo
tools.description:
Read HotRepo's full review of a repository (Markdown), with its stats, topic, daily trending history (the all-languages board; each day's
    best_github_rank_that_day is the best position it reached on GitHub's page that day, null before 2026-10-24) and
    Hacker News threads that link to it. fork

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description:
Search repositories that HotRepo has reviewed, newest reviews first. Use get_repo for the full review.
    Free returns at most 10 results per call.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description:
List HotRepo's topics (each reviewed project belongs to exactly one, by what it helps people do) with the
    number of reviewed projects in each.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: List reviewed repositories in one topic, most recently trending first. Free returns at most 10 per call.

tools.name: get_monthly_report
tools.description:
Get a HotRepo monthly report: the repositories that gained the most stars on the daily trending board during
    a month, the most notable new repositories, and leaders per topic, with an editorial introduction.

tools.name: get_weekly_digest
tools.description:
Get a HotRepo weekly digest, the weekly email also published on hotrepo.ai/weekly: an editorial introduction
    (a headline and a few themes), the week's 10 biggest gainers, notable new repositories, and each day's top gainer.
    stars_that_week is the highest star count seen that week, not today'

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.description:
List the repositories the API key's owner has favorited on hotrepo.ai, most recently favorited first, with
    HotRepo's one-line review when one is published. Use get_repo for the full review. Favorites are added on the
    website's project pages, not through this server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_trending, get_repo, search_repos, get_weekly_digest, list_favorites, get_similar_repos · Private data: get_trending, list_favorites, get_star_history, compare_repos, get_favorite_releases · Public sink: get_weekly_digest · Destructive: get_trending.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_trending, get_repo, search_repos, get_weekly_digest, list_favorites, get_similar_repos · Private data: get_trending, list_favorites, get_star_history, compare_repos, get_favorite_releases · Public sink: get_weekly_digest · Destructive: get_trending

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
